Dated this the 16th day of November, 2023 Apprehending arrest in Crime No.1066 of 2023 of Thalayolaparambu Police Station, Kottayam, registered for offences under Sections 406 and 420 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code, the accused Nos.1 and 2 have filed this petition.

2. The prosecution case is that the petitioners with a fraudulent intention to cheat the defacto complainant, purchased gold ornaments from the shop of the defacto complainant dated on 04.07.2023, 05.07.2023, 07.07.2023 and 11.07.2023 respective dates total worth of Rs.47,79,111/-
on advance payment.
The petitioners could not make the balance payment as promised by them.
3. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor were heard.
4. Considering the allegations against the petitioners of purchasing gold ornaments amounting to Rs.47,79,111/- under different bills and paying only the advance portion of the amount.
The records produced show the involvement of the petitioners in the offence alleged requiring a proper investigation.
In such circumstances, I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail as it will affect a proper investigation.
5. Therefore, the following directions are issued:-

In the event the petitioner surrenders before the Investigating Officer in two weeks,
she shall be interrogated and thereafter, shall be produced before the Magistrate having jurisdiction on the date of surrender itself.
If the petitioner moves for bail, the court below shall, untrammelled by any of the observations in this order, consider the bail application on merits, as expeditiously as possible.
If the petitioner does not surrender before the Investigating Officer, as directed above, the Investigating Officer will be free to arrest the petitioner as if no order has been passed in this case.
The bail application is disposed of as above.
